# GEMBA Team

> GEMBA Team EOOD (EIK: 208656371) is a Bulgarian company uniting industrial services and IT solutions under one roof. Founded in 2026 in Varna, Bulgaria, by Slavcho Ivanov — a professional with over 10 years of hands-on reactor servicing experience at Shell, ExxonMobil, BP, Neste, and ORLEN, combined with 20+ years of IT infrastructure, DevOps, full-stack development, and blockchain expertise.

## Company Structure

GEMBA Team operates through two divisions:

### Industrial Services (gembaindustrial.com)
- Catalyst changeout operations and reactor servicing
- Supervision of refinery turnarounds and planned maintenance shutdowns
- Crew deployment across major European refineries
- SCC/VCA certified (TÜV Rheinland), BA/N2 inert entry qualified

### IT Solutions (gembait.com)
- Full-stack software development (Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MariaDB)
- Linux server infrastructure and DevOps on Hetzner cloud
- Payment system integration (Stripe, PayPal)
- Smart-contract development and security auditing (Solidity, EVM networks)
- Real-time monitoring systems for servers and industrial infrastructure
- Access control systems, video surveillance, admin panels
- MVP development and ongoing maintenance subscriptions

## Products

### GembaPay (gembapay.com)
Payment gateway for merchants: card and PayPal checkout through a single API integration, built on Stripe Connect and PayPal Partner Commerce. Merchants receive funds directly into their own accounts — funds are never held. 1% platform fee. The infrastructure runs in production; the merchant base is still being built.

### Atlas (In Development)
Modular SaaS platform for workforce and operations management in industrial sectors — refineries, shipyards, catalyst changeout companies, railway operators, and construction. Features include shift planning, check-in/check-out, inventory tracking, digital work permits, and AI assistant.
